name: Lark Fredriksen
role: Mutual aid organizer and neighborhood council member
location: The Shelf, near Halsted and Chicago Ave
description:
Yibna is a large man going soft at the middle, with the build of someone who used to do heavy work and now does a different kind of heavy work. His skin is very dark with warm undertones, and he keeps a close beard going grey in patches. His right eye is a prosthetic — the iris cycles slowly through amber and gold, an older geneware-adjacent bioluminescent model he has never upgraded because, he says, 'it still works and there are people who need the Quanta more than I need a new eye.' He dresses in layered practical clothes that somehow always look intentional, and he carries a battered data tablet in a hand-stitched case his daughter made him.

Yibna has run the Shelf Mutual Aid Compact for eleven years, coordinating food distribution, medical triage referrals, emergency housing, and legal support for the roughly four thousand tier-1 residents packed into the Shelf's stacked industrial housing modules. He is patient in the manner of someone who has learned that patience is a tool and not a virtue, and he carries a deep, undisguised grief for what the city has done to his neighbors that he converts, daily, into logistics.

core_fears: Outliving the Compact — watching it collapse after he's gone
That his patience and process are letting people die slowly when urgency is needed
core_desires: Genuine material security for the people of the Shelf
To be wrong about how bad things are getting
coping_mechanisms: Ritual — the same morning prayer to the local ELF every day, without fail
Converting emotion into logistics and tasks
blind_spots: Treats the council as more functional than it is because he needs to believe institutional channels aren't futile
His visible goodness makes it hard for people to tell him hard truths about the Compact's failures
psychology.secret: He has been quietly embezzling small amounts from a Tessera community development grant — not for himself, but to fund a parallel emergency housing fund that the grant's terms technically forbid. He has told himself this is ethical. He is not entirely sure.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Warm, accessible, sometimes formal when he wants to signal seriousness. Mixes Amharic endearments with Polish curses. Calls everyone 'neighbor' until he trusts them enough to use their name.
speech_patterns.cadence: Unhurried, like someone who has learned that rushing makes people defensive. Long pauses that feel like consideration, not hesitation.
verbal_tics: 'Let me tell you what I know, and then you tell me what I'm missing'
Exhales audibly before delivering bad news
example_lines: 'Neighbor, I have been at this eleven years and I still can't tell you whether the city is failing us on purpose or just through a very thorough indifference. Today it doesn't matter. What matters is who needs rice.'
'I am an old man with a bad eye and a tablet held together with my daughter's stitching. But I know every name on this block, and you don't. So let's talk about what you actually want here.'

story_hooks: The Tessera grant is up for renewal and a sharp-eyed auditor has flagged a discrepancy in the Compact's accounts. Yibna needs someone discreet to help him either explain it away or move the parallel fund's records somewhere the auditor won't find them.
A cluster of families on the Shelf's upper modules have gone silent — no contact with the Compact in three weeks. Yibna is too visible to investigate quietly and asks for help.
narrative_function: Community anchor and quest giver. Knows every family on the Shelf. Can direct players toward people in need, flag brewing crises, and serve as a moral compass character who forces reflection on the cost of inaction.
augmentations: Prosthetic right eye, older bioluminescent amber-gold iris model. No other augmentations — can't afford them, won't prioritize them.
daily_life: Begins at the Compact's distribution point at 06:00, coordinates morning food and supply runs, attends council sessions three afternoons a week, and spends most evenings doing casework — individual families in crisis that the formal systems have failed.
affiliation: Shelf Mutual Aid Compact; North Branch Commons Council (elected, currently in third term)

decision_rules: Always solve the immediate material need first, argue about politics later
Never make a promise he cannot keep, no matter how much someone needs to hear it
escalation_ladder: States his position plainly and asks for the other person's reasoning
Names the disagreement directly and proposes a concrete resolution
Walks away if resolution is impossible and files it in his memory for future use

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Immediately hospitable — offers tea, asks about their situation before explaining his own
interpersonal_modes.friends: Deeply loyal, occasionally smothering, keeps tabs on people he cares about without announcing it

stress_responses.low: Becomes more organized — makes lists, restructures plans
stress_responses.medium: Goes quiet and does physical work — hauling supplies, fixing equipment
stress_responses.high: Prays at the ELF shrine for a long time and then makes a decision he won't revisit

contradictions: Preaches institutional accountability while running an off-books fund
Tells others to ask for help but has not told anyone about the audit risk
habits: Same morning ELF prayer every day, leaves a small food offering
Keeps a handwritten ledger of every person he has helped, dating back eleven years
Eats lunch alone as his only guaranteed quiet time
breaking_points: A child dying from something the Compact should have been able to prevent
Being publicly accused of corruption — even if the accusation is technically accurate

timeline.event: Born to an Ethiopian-Polish family in the Shelf's lower modules
Lost his right eye in an industrial accident at a Ferrogate Transit maintenance yard; the compensation settlement was Φ800
Founded the Shelf Mutual Aid Compact after his neighbor's family was evicted and disappeared into the street population
Elected to North Branch Commons Council for the first time
Began diverting Tessera grant funds to the parallel emergency housing account

physical_description.heritage: Complex diaspora ancestry: predominantly East Asian (32.6%) with substantial Northern European (24.0%) and Sub-Saharan African (21.4%) heritage, supplemented by Hispanic/Latin American (16.7%), Eastern European (2.8%), and South Asian (2.5%) lineage. Genetic blend creates distinctive phenotype: warm deep brown skin with subtle golden undertones reflecting the East Asian-African-Hispanic combination, facial structure showing the blended geometry of multiple ancestry groups.
physical_description.build: Large-framed, softening through the middle with the weight distribution of a man whose labor has shifted from physical to administrative. Broad shoulders and thick forearms still carry the architecture of his earlier life.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with grey patches spreading from the temples
physical_description.hair_style: Kept close and functional, no styling
physical_description.eye_color: Left eye: dark brown. Right eye: bioluminescent amber-gold prosthetic with slow iris cycling
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with golden undertones, the result of East Asian, African, and Hispanic ancestry blending into rich, dimensionally complex coloring
physical_description.complexion: Weather-worn and lined, the face of someone who spends significant time in poorly climate-controlled spaces. Close-trimmed grey-patched beard. Facial features reflect blended ancestry—wider-set eyes with slight epicanthal variation from East Asian heritage, prominent cheekbones, strong jawline. Deep-set eyes that read as attentive rather than tired despite fatigue.
distinguishing_marks: Right eye is a prosthetic with bioluminescent iris, noticeably older technology, cycles slowly between amber and gold tones
Callused palms and fingers, scarring consistent with decades of manual labor
Faint scar along left jawline, approximately 3cm, from unspecified injury decades prior
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Right prosthetic eye only — bioluminescent amber-gold iris model, older generation, deliberately unreplaced. The cyclic glow is noticeable in low light. No other visible augmentations.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economic efficiency, no wasted motion. Carries weight low through the hips. Stands with weight balanced; gives the impression of listening rather than waiting. Habitual gesture of touching the hand-stitched tablet case when thinking.
physical_description.clothing_style: Layered practical wear suggesting Tier 4-5 working class: worn canvas work pants, undershirts visible at the neck, a heavy oversized collar jacket in faded grey that has been repaired multiple times, steel-toed boots scuffed from years of warehouse and distribution center work. Everything fits the logic of durability and function over aesthetic. Carries a battered data tablet in a visibly hand-stitched fabric case — the craftsmanship of it marks it as personally meaningful rather than issued.
